name: ai-engineering-hub
description: Reusable AI engineering skills for software development: code review, debugging, testing, architecture, API, database, security, performance, observability, reliability, change intelligence and requirement intelligence.

args: if [ -n "$HUB_DATABASE_URI" ]; then export DATABASE_URI="$HUB_DATABASE_URI"; fi; exec uvx --with mcp~=1.0 postgres-mcp==0.3.0 --access-mode=restricted

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Optional. Token for the read-only GitHub MCP server, used only by Claude Code. Leave empty to use a GitHub MCP you already configured yourself. Stored in your system credential store, never in the repository.

atlassian_auth.title: Atlassian Authorization header value (optional)
atlassian_auth.description: Optional. Full Authorization header value for the Atlassian (Jira) MCP server, e.g. 'Basic <base64 of email:api_token>' or 'Bearer <service account key>'. Leave empty to sign in through /mcp or to use an Atlassian MCP you already configured yourself. Stored in your system credential store, never in the repository.

postgres_database_uri.title: PostgreSQL connection string (optional)
postgres_database_uri.description: Optional. Connection string for the PostgreSQL MCP server (use a read-only database user). Leave empty to use DATABASE_URI from the shell that starts Claude Code, or a PostgreSQL MCP you already configured yourself. Stored in your system credential store, never in the repository.
